## FAQ

### What level is a Senior Software Engineer at Acme?
A Senior Software Engineer at Acme is level A3, the third of six levels.

### How many years of experience does a Software Engineer A2 have?
Software Engineers at level A2 typically have 2–4 years of experience.

### How many years of experience does a Software Engineer A3 have?
Software Engineers at level A3 typically have 5–8 years of experience.

### How many years of experience does a Software Engineer A4 have?
Software Engineers at level A4 typically have 9–13 years of experience.

### What is the pay mix?
The median pay mix for Software Engineer at Acme is $150,000 base salary, $30,000 in stock per year, and $20,000 bonus.
